scripts.build: vp run build:linux && vp run build:electron
scripts.test: vp run test:linux && vp run test:electron
scripts.check: vp run check:tools && vp run check:linux && vp run check:electron
scripts.check:linux: cargo fmt --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test:collector: cargo build --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --bins && vp -C electron run build && vp -C electron exec node scripts/desktop.ts vp run test:collector
scripts.measure:linux: cargo run --release --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --example observer_measurements && cargo run --release --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --example runtime_measurements
scripts.check:tools: vp fmt --check linux/scripts package.json tsconfig.json && vp lint linux/scripts && vp exec tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.validate:setup: cargo build --release --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --bins && vp exec node linux/scripts/record_setup.ts && vp exec node linux/scripts/render_setup.ts
